objective: Add a focused Getting started guidance component connecting existing factory progress, real school/crew preparation, transport and actual Army needs through ordinary navigation.

ownership.authoritative: Existing receiving, construction, training, rear people, vehicle, dispatch and military supply owners.
ownership.projection: Detached current facts. Reuse FactoryPlan and ArmySupplyView, with no quest owner, saved progress, copied inventory or added history.
ownership.presentation: Scene-owned DemoGuidancePanel; lead mounts it in existing Getting started and routes action_requested(String) through current shell navigation.
ownership.integration: Lead owns command_shell/base_demo/main changes; this component branch does not edit those files.

commands: Navigation only. No purchase, resource grant, staffing change, recipe change, manifest or automatic resume is issued by guidance.
timed_work: None. A burst schedules at most one deferred visible refresh. No _process, _physics_process, timer, time_advanced subscription or continuous polling.
lifecycle: Hidden events preserve dirty state without queries; showing reads fresh facts. Bind/replacement clears action before a deferred read. Refresh resolves current session. Old subscriptions disconnect on bind/exit; no deferred read after removal.
failures: Missing works/park/truck, unseated driver or fuel
Active return trip is not a missing truck
No actual Army need does not invent a shortage
HQ starting stock/receipt is not newly made supply or frontline use
safeguards: Use the smallest existing owner facts per real update; do not export the world.
Use scene-owned subscriptions and current-session reads with safe disconnects.
Preserve real cancellation, custody and stock accounting; navigation cannot perform gameplay commands.
Report component evidence separately from ordinary full-loop, native-input and FPS acceptance.
frozen_acceptance: Opening remains unmanufactured and routes to actual worker controls without mutating ledger or owner records.
Existing physical worker arrival and Materials/Munitions construction/manufacture move the reused factory guidance forward; real completed output is required.
School/vehicle blockers derive from current construction, qualifications and registered truck state; cancellation and session replacement cannot retain stale readiness.
Army guidance retains actual stock coverage, held intent and HQ/frontline distinction; no absent demand is called a production requirement.

Panel renders one primary navigation action plus direct Training, Vehicles and Army needs links; idle/hidden frames do not poll, committed bursts coalesce, logistics-only changes refresh, rebind/exit disconnect old owners.
Focused direct headless Godot checker passes; map/UI map checks pass with all new/changed function purposes examined.
limits: One manual execution owner. Short headless direct checks only; no foreground input, broad suite, benchmark, native goal or retry daemon. Existing FPS failures remain open; eventual target is 60 FPS. No source assets added.
